module_metadata.purpose: @tool scripts, @export_tool_button, EditorPlugin, EditorInterface singleton, and EditorUndoRedoManager.

tool_script_rules.header: @tool must be the very first token on line 1 of the `.gd` file.
tool_script_rules.scene_tree_owner_rule: When spawning nodes procedurally inside an `@tool` script in the editor, you MUST set `instance.owner = get_tree().edited_scene_root` AFTER `add_child(instance)`, otherwise the spawned nodes will not appear in the Scene dock or save into the `.tscn` file!

editor_interface_4_7.rule: In Godot 4.2–4.7, `EditorInterface` is a global singleton (`EditorInterface.get_selection()`, `EditorInterface.get_edited_scene_root()`). Do NOT call the removed Godot 3.x `get_editor_interface()` method.
